stories.title: With the Rise of AI Agents, SOC 2 Should Adapt or Risk Irrelevance
stories.summary: AI agents can operate through human credentials and take actions that existing SOC 2 controls may not distinguish from human activity. Token Security explains why SOC 2 needs to adapt to address the security gaps created by agent identities.

stories.title: Rydox marketplace admin pleads guilty, faces 22 years in prison
stories.summary: A Kosovar national has pleaded guilty to operating Rydox, a large illegal online marketplace that sold stolen personal information, login credentials, credit card details, and cybercrime tools.

stories.title: AI-Generated Phishing Pages Are Impersonating Antivirus Services
